name: FLA_OBLIGATIONS_INT
description: FLA_OBLIGATIONS_INT contains lease terms for obligations.

columns.name: INTERFACE_OBLIGATION_ID
columns.description: Interface Lease obligation identifier. This column constitutes primary key along with LOAD_REQUEST_ID column of the table.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Enterprise Scheduler: request identifier of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: INTERFACE_LEASE_ID
columns.description: Lease identifier. It references the primary key of the FLA_LEASES_ALL table.

columns.name: OBLIGATION_NUMBER
columns.description: Obligation number as generated by the system. Provide this when performing an amendment.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of obligation as entered by the user.

columns.name: OBLIGATION_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the obligation defined. Provide this when performing an amendment.

columns.name: OBLIGATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of obligation which is defined.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: State date of the obligation as entered by the user.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: End date of the obligation as entered by the user.

columns.name: VENDOR_ID
columns.description: Supplier identifier which is attached to the obligation.

columns.name: VENDOR_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique number to identify a supplier.

columns.name: VENDOR_NAME
columns.description: Supplier name. Name of the supplier.

columns.name: REFERENCE_DETAILS
columns.description: Reference details of the obligation.

columns.name: RESPONSIBILITY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Responsibility type defined for the obligation.

columns.name: PAID_BY_VENDOR_ID
columns.description: Supplier responsible for paying the obligation.

columns.name: PAID_BY_VENDOR_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique number to identify a supplier who has done the payment for the obligation.

columns.name: PAID_BY_VENDOR_NAME
columns.description: Supplier name. Name of the supplier who has done the payment  for the obligation.

columns.name: PERCENTAGE_PAID
columns.description: Percent of the obligation paid by the supplier.

columns.name: OVERSEER_DETAILS
columns.description: Details of the overseer of the obligation.

columns.name: OBLIGATION_AMOUNT
columns.description: Obligation amount as entered by the user.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code for the obligation amount.

columns.name: PAID_BY_VENDOR_CODE
columns.description: Paid by vendor details. Values can be LANDLORD, LESSEE, MANAGER and so forth.

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_1
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_2
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: AMEND_ACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Amend action type which identifies which action is being performed. Values could be INSERT or UPDATE.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
